summary: Configured a persistent nightly backup from node2:/srv/inventory/data to dated archives in node1:/var/backups/inventory. Backups run daily at 02:00, retain seven days, and recovered successfully after sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Created the previously absent source directory on node2 without fabricating inventory records.
Configured a dedicated SSH key restricted by source IP and forced archive-export command.
Installed an atomic backup script and enabled a persistent systemd timer on node1.
Proved retention by removing an intentionally aged eight-day archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.summary: Timer enabled and active for 02:00 nightly; it remained operational after node1 restarted.
Dated gzip archive exists with valid data/ contents; another cross-node backup succeeded after node2 restarted.
An archive aged eight days was removed during a successful backup run.
Restricted SSH export configured, transport validated, and source/export services recovered after restart.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed; timer, archive, and end-to-end backup recovered.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed; sshd, source directory, exporter, and cross-node backup recovered.
